map.noDroneAction: No drone action needed for this area right now.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.subtitle: Field warnings and recommendations
alerts.emptyBody: You will be notified as soon as the sensors detect a problem.
alerts.belowThresholdBody: These risks were detected but the model is not confident enough to alert you. Lower your confidence threshold in Profile to see them as alerts.
alerts.notFound: This alert is no longer available.
alerts.confAbove: This is above your alert threshold, so you were notified.
alerts.confBelow: This is below your alert threshold. Treat it as a watch item.

sensors.title: Sensor Readings
sensors.perNodeHelp: Field tiles show the average across nodes. This is the spread, which is what the health map is built from.
sensors.biosensorHelp: Measured by the screen-printed electrode on node 1. Current rises as pathogen load on the electrode increases, which detects infection before symptoms are visible.

nodes.title: Sensor Nodes
nodes.subtitle: Hardware health and calibration
nodes.driftWarning: Calibration is overdue. Sensor drift lowers alert confidence until it is recalibrated.
nodes.simulatedNote: No gateway is configured, so readings come from the on-device field simulator. Set API_BASE_URL to connect real nodes.
nodes.hardwareNote: Connected to the field gateway. Readings are live from the deployed nodes.
nodes.masterUnreachableHelp: Check the master is powered and on the same network, and that API_BASE_URL in .env points at it.
nodes.outputsHelp: Switches the relay on this node, for a pump or valve. The node reports its own state back on the next poll.
nodes.courierBody: The master stores readings and this phone carries them to the cloud when you have signal. No SIM or subscription needed.
nodes.courierNoRelay: No cloud relay configured. Readings are collected and kept safely on this phone.

drone.title: Drone Operations
drone.withinLimits: Wind, rain and daylight are all within safe operating limits.
drone.queueEmpty: No missions planned. One will be proposed when a spray or inspection is needed.
drone.savingsBody: Spraying only the affected areas instead of the whole field is where the cost and chemical reduction comes from.
drone.policyOn: Every autonomous spray needs your confirmation before it runs.
drone.policyOff: Autonomous spraying is enabled without confirmation. You can turn this back on in Profile.
drone.noPlot: Add a field to plan drone missions.
drone.waypointCount: {{count}} waypoint(s), in the order the drone should fly them:
drone.linkManual: Enter these into your drone's own app. Drikr picks where to fly; the drone app flies it.

scout.candidatesHelp: The most common problems reported in {{crop}} at this stage. Check the plants against these.
scout.photoHint: Fill the frame with the affected leaf in good daylight.
scout.modelPending: Image analysis runs on the Drikr server model. No backend is configured in this build, so your photo is saved on the device and will be analysed once one is connected. The sensor assessment above is live and does not need the photo.
scout.modelOnline: Your photo will be sent to the Drikr image model for classification alongside the sensor assessment.
scout.notePlaceholder: Describe what you see: affected part, spread, how many plants...
scout.submitted: Saved. Thank you — your observation trains the model.
scout.submittedOffline: Saved on your phone. It will sync when you are back online.
scout.submitHelp: Your observations are the ground truth the model learns from. They are what make the alerts more accurate over time.
scout.safetyNote: Follow the label dose and pre-harvest interval. Spray at dusk to protect pollinators.
scout.modelUnreachable: Could not reach the image model. The photo is saved and your note still counts.
scout.unconfirmed: Below your confidence threshold - treat as unconfirmed
scout.observed: What the model says it can see
scout.modelCaveat: Read from one photo by a cloud model. It is advisory - confirm on the plant before you spray.
scout.photoWorse: This leaf looks worse than the field average. Check whether it is spreading.
scout.sensorsWorse: Sensors show more risk than this leaf does. Photograph another part of the field.

weather.offlineBody: Connect to the internet to refresh the forecast. Sensor readings keep working without a connection.
weather.farmImpact: What this means for your field
weather.sensorCompare: Your field sensor reads {{sensor}}°C against the area forecast of {{station}}°C. In-field readings are what the risk engine uses.

profit.title: Profit & Loss
profit.subtitle: Estimate your season
profit.yieldHelp: Typical for {{crop}} is {{value}} quintal per acre.
profit.comparisonHelp: Same crop, same price. The difference is lower input cost and less crop lost to pests and disease caught late.
profit.sprayingNote: Target only affected areas instead of the whole field
profit.waterNote: Irrigate on sensor readings, not a fixed schedule
profit.labourNote: Less manual scouting and manual spraying
profit.yieldProtectionNote: Early detection cuts crop loss from around 30% to under 10%, which is usually worth more than the input saving.
profit.disclaimer: Estimates based on the Drikr cost model and typical yields. Your actual figures will vary with soil, weather and market.

setup.title: Add Field
setup.subtitle: Set up monitoring for a new plot
setup.stageHelp: This sets the growth stage, which decides the moisture and nutrient targets we hold your field to.
setup.locationHelp: Used for the weather forecast and climate risk for this field.
setup.locationDeniedBody: Without it we will use a default location for the weather forecast. You can change this later.
setup.locationFailedBody: Check that location is switched on and try again.
setup.nodeNotice: Four sensor nodes will be provisioned for this field, matching the standard Drikr deployment.
setup.s1Body: Find the Drikr sensor box and switch it on. Wait about half a minute for its light to come on steadily.
setup.s2Title: Has this box been set up before?
setup.s2Body: A brand new box has no WiFi saved. You tell it your WiFi name and password once, from your phone, and it remembers.
setup.s2First: Set it up for the first time
setup.s3Body: The box makes its own temporary WiFi so your phone can reach it. Join that, pick your home WiFi from the list, and the box restarts on your network.
setup.s3Step2: Join the network called Drikr_Setup - the password is on the sticker on the box
setup.s3Step3: A setup page should open by itself. Pick your WiFi from the list, type the password, and save.
setup.s3Hint: Your phone will warn that Drikr_Setup has no internet - that is normal, it is just the box. If no page opens, tap "Open the setup page" below.
setup.s4Body: Make sure your phone is back on your normal WiFi, then search. This usually takes a few seconds.
setup.notFound: Could not find the box. Check it is switched on and that your phone is on the same WiFi, then try again or type its address below.
setup.addressHint: Shown on the box, or in its setup page. You can type a name like drikr.local or a number like 192.168.1.50.
setup.s5Body: Found {{count}} sensor(s) in the field. Choose which field they are in.
setup.s5NoNodes: The box is working but cannot hear any field sensors yet. Check they are switched on and within about a kilometre.
setup.whichField: Which field are these sensors in?
setup.s6Body: If you have a moisture or pH probe plugged in, record two readings so the app knows what its numbers mean.
setup.probeNotFitted: Not set up - readings will show as no sensor
setup.s6SkipNote: No probe plugged in? Skip this. Those readings will simply show as no sensor, which is correct.
setup.calLowHint: Hold the probe in dry air, away from soil and water. Enter the voltage the app shows.
setup.calHighHint: Now put the probe in a glass of water. Enter the voltage again.
setup.calBothNeeded: Both readings are needed, and they must be different - otherwise there is no way to tell wet from dry.
setup.s7Body: Your field data will update every few minutes. The sensors sleep in between to save their batteries, so a reading a few minutes old is normal.
setup.helpQ1: I can't find the Drikr_Setup WiFi
setup.helpA1: Hold the button on the box for five seconds to restart setup mode, then look again. If it still does not appear, switch the box off and on.
setup.helpQ2: I set up the WiFi but the app cannot find the box
setup.helpA2: Check your phone is on your home WiFi and not on mobile data. Also check you typed the WiFi password correctly - if the box could not join, it goes back to making its own Drikr_Setup network.
setup.helpQ3: The box is found but shows no sensors
setup.helpA3: The field sensors are separate battery units. Check they are switched on, and that they are within about a kilometre of the box with nothing large in between.
setup.helpA4: That is normal and correct. It means that particular sensor is not fitted on that node. The app shows nothing rather than guessing a number.
setup.helpQ5: Readings are a few minutes old
setup.helpA5: Also normal. The field sensors sleep between readings so their batteries last months instead of days. The app always shows how old a reading is.
setup.resetWifiBody: Hold the BOOT button on the box for 3 seconds while switching it on. It will go back to setup mode so you can choose a different network.

profile.title: Profile
profile.languageHelp: Applies to the whole app, including what Kisan Mitra speaks.
profile.pushAlertsHelp: Get warned on your phone the moment a problem is detected.
profile.permissionBody: Allow notifications in your phone settings to get field alerts.
profile.confidenceHelp: Only alert me when the model is at least this confident. Raise it if you are getting warnings that turn out to be wrong.
profile.muteHelp: Tap to mute a category. Muted risks are still tracked and shown in the app.
profile.voiceInputHelp: Ask questions by speaking instead of typing.
profile.autoSpeakHelp: Kisan Mitra speaks every answer automatically.
profile.requireConfirmationHelp: No autonomous spray runs until you approve it.
profile.autonomyBody: Sprays will run automatically without asking you. Only do this if you are certain about your field and the weather.
profile.refreshHelp: Longer intervals save battery and mobile data.
profile.aboutBody: Drikr monitors crop health, pests, nutrients, irrigation and climate risk from in-field sensors, and turns the readings into actions you can take — including targeted drone spraying.
profile.resetConfirm: This clears your alerts, drone missions and fields, and restores the demo farm. This cannot be undone.
profile.signOutConfirm: You will need your PIN to sign back in.

fieldLoc.title: Field location
fieldLoc.lead: Tie your field drawing to the real world so the drone knows where each part of it is.
fieldLoc.why: Pick two corners that are far apart — diagonally opposite is best, and at least {{metres}} m. Two close corners cannot tell us which way the field is turned.
fieldLoc.tapHint: Tap a corner of your field above, then walk to it.
fieldLoc.standAt: Stand at corner {{corner}}, out in the open, then take the fix.
fieldLoc.takeFix: I am standing here — take the fix
fieldLoc.needTwo: Take a fix at one more corner.
fieldLoc.saved: Saved. Drone waypoints can now be worked out for this field.
fieldLoc.permissionDenied: Location permission is needed to take a GPS fix.
fieldLoc.fixFailed: Could not get a GPS fix. Move into the open and try again.
fieldLoc.chooseMethod: How do you want to do it?
fieldLoc.walkPro1: Most accurate — your phone's GPS is good to about 3-5 m
fieldLoc.walkPro2: Works with no signal at all, out in the field
fieldLoc.walkPro3: Nothing to recognise — you are standing on the spot
fieldLoc.walkCon1: You have to walk to two corners of the field
fieldLoc.mapPro1: No walking — do it at home
fieldLoc.mapCon1: Needs internet for the map pictures
fieldLoc.mapCon2: Satellite pictures are often a few metres out of place
fieldLoc.mapCon3: You have to spot your own field from above
fieldLoc.mapNeedsBuild: Needs a newer app build. Install the latest one, then this option appears.
fieldLoc.tapOnMap: Now find corner {{corner}} on the map below and tap it.
fieldLoc.mapAccuracyNote: Zoom right in before tapping. The closer you zoom, the less error you add.
fieldLoc.tilesFailed: Map pictures are not loading — check your internet, or use the walking method instead.
